notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land in hand, and are able to put it onto the battlefield.
description:
Put a land onto the battlefield.
Sporemound and Spitfire Lagac both trigger.
Resolve the Spitfire Lagac trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a Saproling Forest creature land token.
Repeat from step 2.
